Indian Standard 

PROCEDURE FOR SPLASH PROOF TESTING OF 
AUTOMOTIVE VEHICLES 



1. Scope — Covers the splash proof testing of cars, jeeps, trucks and buses. 

2. Features of Test Track — The test track shall be a shallow water trough of 1 00 m long, 6 m wide 
and with the water depth of 500 mnn. Ramps shall be provided at both ends of the track. 

3. Preparation of the Vehicfe 

3.1 The vehicle shall conform in allits parts and components to the design and/or production 
series as applicable. 

3.2 The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the manufacturer. 

3.3 The vehicle shall be run in as per manufacturer's recommendations. 

3.4 The vehicle shall be loaded to the specified Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW) and the load distri- 
bution between the axles shall be as per recommendations of the vehicle manufacturer, 

4. Test Procedure 

4.1 After preparation as in 3, the vehicle shall be driven trough the shallow water trough twice at 
speeds each of 25 km/h and 40 km/h. During the test 150 mm water depth shall be kept for cars 
and jeeps whereas 250 mm depth shall be kept for trucks and buses. 

4.2 During each run, ingress of water in the vehicle, if any, shall be recorded. The water ingress 
may be from the floor of the vehicle, foot controls, cab doors and windows due to splash. The 
effects of the water splash on components in engine compartments shall be observed and recorded. 
Effect of water splash on the windscreen like very poor visibility shall also be recorded. Performance 
of brakes and other components of the vehicle shall also be checked for safety. 

4.3 The vehicle shall be in a fit condition to drive aft3r completion of the splash proof test in order 
to conform to the requirements of this standard. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The automotive vehicles shall have an assured performance under and after going through the 
prevailing conditions of their operation on city roads, highway, etc. At times vehicles have to cross 
the stagnating water or otherwise to pass through some water logging areas. 

This Indian Standard gives procedure for splash proof testing of automotive vehicles so that the 
test procedure is applied on uniform basis by all concerned. 



Adopted 25 July 1986
